environment.gravity_direction: World down after choosing mounting orientation; CAD world axes are not automatically world gravity axes.
environment.hydrodynamic_drag: disabled; no water parameters carried into dry-air model
environment.mount: Fixed base only if physically clamped; free base requires stand/support mass and ground contacts

actuator.limits_recommendation: Use <=5Nm output torque as initial rated simulation ceiling, explicitly conditional on manufacturer cooling and supply conditions. This is not a guarantee of sustainable holding torque on this arm. Keep14Nm only as a labeled transient specification; disable boosted peak simulation until duration/thermal envelope is known. No-load33rad/s is not a usable loaded speed guarantee. A1rad/s initial simulation speed cap is a chosen conservative demo setting, not hardware evidence.
actuator.transmission: Published torque/speed are actuator output values. Apply ratio exactly once if modeling internal rotor; do not multiply14Nm or5Nm by10 again.
thermal_unknowns: Power supply voltage/current and regenerative behavior
actuator.mass_distribution: For first rigid-body model assign each full0.310kg envelope to body carrying its housing. CAD normalized COM/inertia approximates motor interior. Do not duplicate full mass on output side. Internal rotor and rotating output inertia are unknown; reflected rotor inertia would be N^2*Jrotor, separate from stator housing spatial inertia. Leave explicit unmodeled/zero-proxy flag rather than invent measured rotor inertia.
actuator.friction_damping: Unknown. Prefer zero physical friction/damping in transparent ideal baseline; numerical damping if needed must be separately labeled. Perform sensitivity sweeps and later fit Coulomb, viscous, deadband, backlash, compliance from data.
actuator.control: Use torque-limited controllers with finite stiffness and damping. Tune gains against modeled effective inertia and timestep; do not use infinitely stiff position constraints as an actuator-physics claim.

mass_model.steel_density_status: Conventional generic steel proxy; CAD bearing/guide envelopes may contain voids, seals and balls and are not reliable fully-solid masses.
mass_model.camera_recommendation: Parameterize camera mass and normalized geometry inertia independently. Weigh or identify before mass accuracy claims. If runnable model requires a nominal value, choose and expose an explicit engineering placeholder (e.g.0.025kg); it is not a measured estimate or manufacturer specification.
mass_model.missing_mass: Cables, connectors, fasteners absent from CAD, payload, external supports and any unmodeled internals remain unknown. Do not inflate density across all links to hide missing mass; add located mass items when known.
mass_model.ambiguous_components: Jaw fingers42/43, finger rings44/45, cuff59 and camera support70 are NOT confirmed6061. Initial2700kg/m3 is only a provisional engineering proxy. User confirmation or weighing takes priority. Primary structural brackets holding actuators use user-provided likely6061 assumption.

inertia_method.from_BREP: Use per-solid exact closed BREP volume and inertia rather than triangle mesh approximations. Inspection script GProp center-of-mass tensor is expressed in assembly orientation.
inertia_method.density_conversion: mass_kg=volume_mm3*rho_kg_m3*1e-9; I_kg_m2=I_mm5*rho_kg_m3*1e-15. For manufacturer mass use I=I_mm5*(mass_kg/volume_mm3)*1e-6.
inertia_method.aggregation: Rotate each COM tensor into link frame; link COM=sum(m*c)/sum(m); sum rotated COM tensors plus m*((d dot d)*identity-outer(d,d)) with d from each part COM to combined COM.
inertia_method.URDF: Inertial origin at link-frame COM; inertia tensor about that COM, expressed in inertial-frame orientation. If origin rpy=0, store tensor in link axes including off-diagonals.
checks: Every moving physical link has positive mass
Principal moments obey triangle inequalities within tolerance
Total mass and global COM conserve across rigid assignments
Total inertia conserves under fixed-part regrouping
CAD mm to m scaling applied once
Avoid duplicate solids from coincident component instances
Audit meshes only for collision/visuals, not mass replacement

gripper.baseline_warning: Old reference indices are not valid for this STEP. Current loops44/45, J7 motor base46, J6 shaft47/48, jaws42/43. Reassign by names and rigid kinematics.
gripper.model_choice: Ideal symmetric two-slider mechanism is acceptable for visual/IK and approximate collision. For physics its jaw travel, motor-to-gap function and effort transmission must be independently defined. Retain mass of omitted drive links; lump into wrist only with stated q-dependent inertia approximation.
gripper.effort_mapping: Let g(q) be total gap vs motor-output angle. For symmetric fingers with equal opposing contact force F per jaw, virtual work gives tau=F*dg/dq. Thus F=tau/(dg/dq), subject to efficiency, friction and singularity handling. If using one-jaw coordinate x=g/2, generalized force conjugate to x is2F. Do not copy Nm motor torque into a prismatic N effort field.
gripper.calibration: Two encoder endpoints do not establish intermediate linkage Jacobian; derive closure geometry or sample measured motor-angle vs gap. Existing104.825mm maximum gap and old endpoint calibration are not proof for this STEP.
gripper.collision: Keep actual loops if physical; omit visual-only pieces only with documented confirmation. Closed-jaw and slider contacts must be distinguished from invalid self-penetration; avoid suppressing all adjacent-link collisions.

validation_priorities: Weigh full arm and link/jaw groups including camera and cables; reconcile CAD bill of mass.
Verify all seven motor housing ownerships and joint axes/signs; CAD pose is near calibrated zero, not exact.
Check gravity torque along representative reachable poses and worst horizontal reaches against conditional5Nm rated envelope; report exceedance rather than raising torque.
Implement joint soft limits from actual mechanism/cable envelope; inherited CAD limits are provisional until checked.
Perform collision sweeps using convex decompositions/primitives with preserved holes/gaps as needed; single convex hull of a U bracket fills empty space.
Check timestep/gain sensitivity and passive-energy behavior; quasi-static gravity hold should require predicted torques without unexplained drift.
Separate mathematical IK success from collision-free, within-limits and torque-feasible success.
Identify reflected inertia, friction/backlash, motor heating and gripper Jacobian before dynamic fidelity or hardware transfer claims.
